purpose: Teach: 配付/減額/必需/構文/造る/充足/取消/買物

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文を学会で配付しろ
lines.en: Ren — distribute the paper at the conference.
lines.style: Clipped, direct instruction. No wasted breath. Calm authority with the weight of experience behind it. Looks at him straight on.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の減額が議題になっております
lines.en: Yes. The research funding cutback is under discussion.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly anxious. Processing the weight of the task while trying to be helpful. Offers context as though it matters to the decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、必需試薬の発注を忘れるな
lines.en: Ren — don't forget to order the essential reagents.
lines.style: Firm, practical. Not a suggestion. The tone of someone who has seen important work derailed by small oversights. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の文章構文を見直しました
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the manuscript structure and syntax.
lines.style: Eager to show readiness, almost over-reporting. Slightly defensive in wanting to prove he's on top of things. Careful, precise delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、世に名を造る研究を目指せ
lines.en: Ren — aim for research that builds your name in the field.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Expectation, not pressure. The voice of someone passing on what he learned. Slower pace, weight on the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究で充足感を得ております
lines.en: Yes. I'm finding real fulfillment in the research.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. Not performing for the boss — actually meaning it. Slight relief in his voice, like he's allowed to admit this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文投稿の取消はしないこと
lines.en: Ren — don't cancel the paper submission.
lines.style: Sharp, knowing. He's read Ren's hesitation before it became words. Not harsh — protective. The finality of someone who won't let self-doubt win.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究用物品の買物リストを整えました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the research supplies shopping list.
lines.style: Quiet relief in accepting the push. Returning to concrete tasks, things he can control. Trailing with a small exhale, as though grounded.
